title: A stale-only lookup revalidation passes Doc.locate the count of the due sources, not the row's real citation count
goal: kbfacts.revalidate_pack with stale_only passes factdiff.revalidate each printed line's full citation count (the sources its row cites, as anchoring counts them) though it asks only the sources past their lifetime, so Doc.locate weighs the row's cells as anchoring does and a two-source row with one source due is not relocated as moved where anchoring would not. Found by the SP-djl7za6x review (BG-f3d6lirf fixed detect and review only).

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kbfacts, factdiff; printed=[{'path':'public/x/y.md','line':3,'key':'k1','text':'t','ids':['S1','S2']}]; res={'results':[{'printed':printed}],'text':'T'}; kbfacts.source_freshness=lambda ids: {'S1':{'stale':False,'lifetime_days':30},'S2':{'stale':True,'lifetime_days':30}}; seen={}; factdiff.revalidate=lambda p, reuse=None: seen.update(p=p) or {'date':'d','lines':{},'sources':{}}; kbfacts.revalidated=lambda t,r,f: t; kbfacts.revalidate_pack(res, stale_only=True); p=seen['p'][0]; sys.exit(0 if p.get('cites', len(set(p['ids'])))==2 else 1)

Found by the SP-djl7za6x review (BG-f3d6lirf fixed detect and review only)

gates.question: How does revalidate_pack hand factdiff.revalidate the row's full citation count when stale_only narrows each printed line's ids to the due sources?

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 3 of 15, "Freshness at lookup: revalidation counts, memos, ledger reads and status agree"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed. Premise run 2026-10-13 at plan time: the repro fails on the base (exit 1: the printed line's ids are narrowed to the one due source, so Doc.locate gets 1, not 2). The fix may add a cites key to the printed items that factdiff.revalidate reads (cites[(key, path)] near factdiff.py line 1622) or keep the ids whole beside the due set. First of the sprint's chain on factdiff.py and kbfacts.py: BG-gx5b2yhu, BG-vzsk2t5t, ST-qkpbwtsc, BG-pcralmzy and ST-gkrivybp follow it. The test file is left out of the touches (the repro runs the changed path): an existing assertion in test_live_kb.py that pins the old count stops the work with a report.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kbfacts, factdiff; printed=[{'path':'public/x/y.md','line':3,'key':'k1','text':'t','ids':['S1','S2']}]; res={'results':[{'printed':printed}],'text':'T'}; kbfacts.source_freshness=lambda ids: {'S1':{'stale':False,'lifetime_days':30},'S2':{'stale':True,'lifetime_days':30}}; seen={}; factdiff.revalidate=lambda p, reuse=None: seen.update(p=p) or {'date':'d','lines':{},'sources':{}}; kbfacts.revalidated=lambda t,r,f: t; kbfacts.revalidate_pack(res, stale_only=True); p=seen['p'][0]; sys.exit(0 if p.get('cites', len(set(p['ids'])))==2 else 1)
